warden: Blue armor absorbs 55% damage for 3 seconds, followed by an exposed amber rush for 1.5 seconds. Keep your escape route open.
bug: The most common process. Weak alone, dangerous in a swarm.
daemon: Faster and sturdier than a bug. Keep moving and it never catches you.
drone: Circles at range and fires slow shots. Firewalls block them.
lancer: Freezes, shows a white line, then charges along it. Step sideways.
split: Breaks into three bugs when destroyed. Kill it away from your path.
watcher: Hangs back and fires down a red line. Break the line or hide behind a firewall.
brute: A slow, armored block of code that hits hard.
leaker: Leaves pools of corrupted data that hurt while you stand in them.
patcher: Reads your strongest code line and patches against it. It and everything near it shrug off that effect. Kill it with your weapons.
scrubber: Hunts your code: it eats pools and pull fields and deletes shards that fly past it. It heals on every bite.
eel: A long chain that weaves toward you. Every segment hurts.
auditor: Marks the ground where you stand, then strikes it. Keep moving.
boss: Freezes, aims, then lunges along a white line. From phase 2 it lunges twice.
collector: Eats the shards you leave behind and grows stronger. Collect fast.
mirror: Fires a fan that grows with every weapon you carry, plus expanding rings.
ghost: Nearly invisible: only a faint shimmer, unless you use Code Sight. Your weapons still hit it.
phantom: Phases out of reach, then turns solid and fires rings. Damage only lands while it is solid.
root: The end of the run. It summons purges, collapses the arena, and strikes the ground in phase 3.
